PC: Did the fellow comprehensively interview the patient and granddaughter? (e.g. why she lives in a NH and why she is frustrated with meals)
Did the fellow complete a thorough physical examination? (i.e. gait assessment and skin [pressure ulcers])?
The fellow was able to develop an appropriate management action plan to improve the functional status of patient (e.g. resume PT/OT)
MK: The fellow was able to identify the cause of patient’s malnutrition. (e.g. restricted diet and high-calorie alcohol use)
The fellow was able to identify poor dentition, sores and alcohol abuse.
ICS: Did the SP understand the physician’s questions?
Did the SP understand the physician’s answers?
Did the SP feel that she played an active role in decision making?
The fellow was able to communicate the issues and plan appropriate with patient using shared decision making with patient and family (when appropriate)?
PROF: Did the physician wash their hands?
Did the SP feel respected by the physician?
Did the physician treat the patient well?
